app_tree_sha_scheme: sha256 over (relative path, file bytes) of every *.py under app/
note:
Pins the snapshot to the app/ tree it describes. The inventory refuses to resolve paths against it when the tree differs.
Re-pinned when issue 241 deleted app/api/auth.py and app/api/admin_ai.py. That is a change to app/ which the snapshot predates, and the re-pin is deliberate rather than a reflex: the deleted modules were never registered in main.py -- verified by AST-parsing every router main.py includes, and by `git log -S`, which finds no commit in the repository's history that ever registered them -- so they served nothing and the published document is identical either side of the deletion. The discriminating evidence is the media type: the published /api/v1/auth/login accepts only application/x-www-form-urlencoded, which is app/auth_routes.py's signature; the deleted handler took a JSON body. operationIds do not discriminate here, because both modules would generate the same ones.
